question: The Government of India in collaboration with ________ has launched the Skills on Wheels mission in Oct 2023 for equipping rural youth with employable skills.
solution:
The correct answer is __**IndusInd Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Government of India launched the **Skills on Wheels Mission** in October 2023, aiming to empower rural youth with employable skills.
 
• The initiative is being implemented in collaboration with **IndusInd Bank**, which plays a key role in supporting the mission.
 
• The Skills on Wheels Mission focuses on providing mobile training units that reach remote and rural areas to offer skill development programs.
 
• These programs target sectors such as **healthcare, IT, retail, and manufacturing** to increase employability among rural youth.
 
• The mission aligns with the Government’s broader goals under the **Skill India initiative** to create a skilled workforce by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Skill India Mission:**

 
 
• Launched in 2015, the Skill India Mission aims to train over 40 crore people in India across various sectors by 2022.
 
• It includes programs like **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)** for short-term training and recognition of prior learning.
 
 
 
• **Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) in Skill Development:**
 
 
• PPPs are collaborations between the government and private organizations like **IndusInd Bank** to improve outreach and efficiency.
 
• They provide funding, expertise, and infrastructure to ensure the success of skill development programs.
 
 
 
• **Mobile Training Units:**
 
 
• These units are equipped with tools, trainers, and resources to deliver skill training in remote and underserved areas.
 
• They help overcome geographical barriers and ensure inclusivity in skill development initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Rural Employment Challenges:**
 
 
• Youth in rural areas often face challenges like lack of access to quality education, training facilities, and employment opportunities.
 
• Government initiatives like Skills on Wheels aim to bridge these gaps and create sustainable livelihoods.
